note: REST Views makes Views REST Export displays serialize fields as real JSON. hook_views_data_alter() adds, for every core 'field' handler, a '<field> (serializable)' handler with plugin_id 'field_export' (class EntityFieldExport, @ViewsField('field_export')), exposed as <field>_export. Output is wrapped in SerializedData (MarkupInterface) and unwrapped by the DataNormalizer (serializer.normalizer.serialized); RenderableData is rendered by RenderNormalizer (serializer.normalizer.render). Export formatters (only work with field_export): boolean_export, number_export, entity_reference_export (opt extra), entity_reference_entity_id_export, entity_path (opt absolute), file_export, image_export (opt export_alt/export_title), link_export, list_export. No settings form, configure route, permissions, Drush, plugin types. Submodules: rest_views_geo, rest_views_revisions, rest_views_search_api. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real REST Export view config (display_options.fields.<f>.plugin_id / type).

evals.prompt: After enabling rest_views, how do I get a Views REST Export field to serialize as proper JSON (e.g. a multi-value field as an array) instead of a flattened string? What is the field handler called?
evals.expected_output: In the view, add the field using its '(serializable)' variant (Views handler plugin_id field_export, exposed as <field>_export). That handler wraps values in SerializedData so they serialize as real data, and automatically exports multi-value fields as arrays based on cardinality.

evals.prompt: Which rest_views field formatters export a boolean as a real JSON boolean and a numeric field as a JSON number, and what handler must the field use for them to work?
evals.expected_output: boolean_export exports a boolean as JSON true/false and number_export exports a numeric field as a JSON number. They only work when the field uses the serializable handler (plugin_id field_export).

evals.prompt: With rest_views, how can I export an entity reference field as a nested object (or just the referenced entity's id) in a REST Export view rather than a rendered HTML string?
evals.expected_output: Use an export formatter on the serializable field: entity_reference_export outputs a nested entity structure (with an optional 'extra' metadata list), entity_reference_entity_id_export outputs just the target id, and entity_path outputs the referenced entity's path/URL.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a REST Export view with machine name rv_known. Inspect its live configuration and report which Views field handler (plugin id) and which formatter its 'nid' field uses.
evals.expected_output: In view rv_known the nid field uses plugin_id field_export (the serializable handler) with the number_export formatter.

evals.prompt: The REST Export view rv_bool on this site exports the node 'status' (published) field. Inspect the live view config and state which rest_views formatter it uses to output that field as a real JSON boolean.
evals.expected_output: The rv_bool view's status field uses the boolean_export formatter (with the field_export serializable handler), so it serializes as a JSON true/false.

evals.prompt: This site has a REST Export view rv_task whose 'title' field currently uses the standard Views field handler. Using rest_views, change that field so it uses the serializable handler (so it will serialize properly for the REST feed). Apply the change to the live view.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.rv_task the default display's title field has plugin_id changed from 'field' to 'field_export' (the serializable handler).

evals.prompt: The REST Export view rv_num on this site already exports the node id (nid) with the serializable handler, but it is using a plain integer formatter, so the value comes out as a string. Using rest_views, set that field's formatter to the one that outputs a real JSON number. Apply the change to the live view.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.rv_num the nid field keeps plugin_id field_export and its 'type' (formatter) is set to number_export.
